title: An Impulsive Anakin… Overwhelmed
front_description: In a secret hangar tower, Count Dooku prepares to leave Geonosis in his personal starship. This hasty retreat is interrupted by the arrival of Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker. "You're going to pay for all the Jedi you killed today, Dooku!" shouts headstrong Anakin, rushing toward his enemy. The confident Dooku easily overwhelms his Jedi antagonist with a blast of Force lightning.
back_description: Actors Ewan McGregor and Hayden Christensen pose together for a publicity photo.
